title: Selma Blair arrested for abusing and injuring flight attendants, authorities say
summary: Actor Selma Blair was taken into custody after a flight from Los Angeles to New York for being physically abusive and injuring two flight attendants, authorities said Monday.

image.caption: Actor Selma Blair is shown arriving at Variety's Power of Women event in Beverly Hills, Calif., on Sept. 23. (Chris Pizzello/The Associated Press)

blocks.text: Actor Selma Blair was taken into custody after a flight from Los Angeles to New York for being physically abusive and injuring two flight attendants, authorities said Monday.
Representative for Cruel Intentions actor says medical emergency led to incident

Blair, 54, was taken into custody late Sunday night when the Delta Air Lines plane was parked at the gate at New York's John F. Kennedy Airport, the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey said in a statement. There was no immediate response to a request for comment from the airline.
Blair and one of the flight attendants were taken to hospital for evaluation, the port authority said.
The FBI is investigating, the statement said. Messages seeking comment were left for the FBI and state and federal prosecutors' offices in New York.
A message left with Blair's publicist seeking comment was not immediately answered.
In a statement to several media outlets, a Blair representative said she had a medical emergency that led to the alleged conduct.
Blair had major roles in such films as 1999's Cruel Intentions, 2001's Legally Blonde and 2004's Hellboy.

In recent years, Blair — who was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis in 2018 — has been an advocate for disability rights. In 2023, she joined then-president Joe Biden at the White House to celebrate the anniversary of the Americans with Disabilities Act.
